scope: Final source-recovery pass for the 19 missing warfare details, 9 missing HeroClassHOMM7 details, 110 missing HeroHOMM7 catalog rows/eligibility values, and H7 CreatureAbility links.
policy: No game was downloaded, no package was executed, and no canonical, schema, database, or GitHub file was changed. Empty additions/fills are deliberate: public search found an auditable official-depot file inventory, but not the raw final package bytes or a complete source-backed transcription. Candidate numeric values, rank vectors, movement, footprint, and Hall flags are not invented.

sources.officialAttribution: The listed paths are files in the Might & Magic Heroes VII Steam content depot; SteamDB is an independent manifest index, not Ubisoft or Valve.
supports: The exact small package names and sizes needed for an auditable final extraction exist in the official game depot.

H7HeroClasses, H7WarfareUnits, H7WarfareUnitAbilities, creature-ability packages, hero packages, building packages, and H7Config are separate files rather than a reason to download the 16.73 GiB depot.
The manifest does not expose package field values or hashes without SteamDB sign-in, so it is a recovery inventory, not row-level evidence.

sources.officialAttribution: SteamDB indexes the official Heroes VII Hungarian depot; the index is not the publisher.
supports: Small localization companions exist for H7HeroClasses, H7WarfareUnits, H7WarfareUnits_Fortress, H7WarfareUnitAbilities, H7WarfareUnitAbilities_F, and all seven H7 town-building packages.
Localization can corroborate object names after extraction, but cannot supply combat stats, ability references, recruitment edges, or Hall-of-Heroes eligibility.
H7 is data-driven through archetypes and packages.
A final package extraction is the appropriate source for creature, ability, building, and hero fields; visual inference and wiki transcription are not substitutes.
Hero enablement is configured per map and player, so catalog-level IsHallHero and map/player availability must not be conflated.
The editor exposes the class and hero properties needed to cross-check extracted package rows.
Public H7 modding/UDK tooling confirms that package/script extraction is a legitimate technical route.
The repository does not contain the official H7 data values and is not used as a source for catalog rows.

sourceRecovery.publicSearchResult: No public raw package export, complete audited JSON/CSV transcription, or official row-level table for these missing H7 values was found. The concrete result is the smallest file set to request from an existing licensed H7 installation or editor export.

requiredFiles.scope: 19 warfare creature details and warfare abilities
expectedEvidence: Warfare archetype identity, rank-specific Attack/Defense/Damage/Health/effect values, initiative and explicit movement/footprint semantics where present.
Ability object references for each warfare unit.
Building archetype references or explicit recruitment arrays for the 19 warfare identities.
requiredFiles.mergeGate: Only package fields or deterministic package references are mergeable. Do not flatten rank vectors into CreatureHOMM7 scalars, map Stationary to Ground/Flying/Teleporting, or convert textual Large/Huge to CombatSize squares.

requiredFiles.scope: 137 detailed H7 creatures without CreatureAbility links

files.manifestSize: individual files listed in the depot manifest; approximately 5.74–9.47 KiB for standard archetypes

expectedEvidence: Creature archetype property references to named H7CrAbilities objects.
Ability kind/effect text sufficient to distinguish passive, activated, triggered, and support mechanics without guessing from names.
requiredFiles.mergeGate: A CreatureAbility row requires an explicit package reference. A missing reference is not equivalent to a confirmed zero-ability creature, and the missing-edge count cannot be inferred from 137 creature rows.

expectedEvidence: Faction identity, class focus/uniqueness, all four growth percentages, and any package-defined skill weights.
The same final build/patch scope as the catalog; do not merge a dated pre-expansion table.
requiredFiles.mergeGate: All required HeroClassHOMM7 fields must come from one final package revision. Do not combine conflicting secondary tables or fill only two growth values.

requiredFiles.scope: 110 missing HeroHOMM7 rows and Hall/availability values
expectedEvidence: Hero code/name/class/faction and any explicit package-level catalog membership.
Hall-of-Heroes or tavern availability only where the package/config explicitly defines it.
Map/player-specific enablement separately, if map packages are later supplied; it must not be collapsed into a global false.
requiredFiles.mergeGate: Do not create 110 false flags from absence. Preserve null/unknown or add a map/player junction only when the source supplies the scope.

blockedFacts: No mergeable H7 row was emitted because package bytes or an equally auditable final extraction were not publicly available in this pass.
The SteamDB manifest establishes exact source filenames, sizes, build and manifest identifiers, but not field values.
No public H6 primary source strong enough to supersede the existing Heroes VI evidence-only blockers was found during the H7-priority search; the existing heroes6.patch.json remains unchanged.
Do not use UCP/community-mod files as vanilla H7 truth: those packages intentionally change abilities, stats, costs, or availability.
